links.outcome: Agreement of AI bone level measurements with periodontist consensus at tooth level
links.effect: Across 2,037 teeth MAE was 5.08% points; mean bias 1.61%; wide limits of agreement, lowest agreement in lower molars (MAE 7.66; R²=0.26), so clinician oversight is needed.
links.quote: However, the limits of agreement, particularly in the molar regions, were too wide to support the use of AI-derived measurements for individual tooth-level assessment without clinician oversight.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the measurement agreement and error of a deep learning model against periodontists on panoramic radiographs, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
